🖨️ RawBT Example 02 - Text Formatting

Bold Text

job.bold(true); job.text('This is BOLD text'); job.bold(false);

Underline Text

job.underline(true); job.text('This is underlined text'); job.underline(false);

Text Sizes

job.textSize(2, 2); // Double width & height job.text('LARGE TEXT'); job.textSize(1, 1); // Normal
